svg.aria-label: Left: a phasor diagram in which a stray signal forty decibels below the main beam adds to a sidelobe thirty decibels down at any phase, so the measured amplitude lies anywhere on a circle around the true value, between plus 2.4 and minus 3.3 decibels. Right: the resulting error interval at three true levels, negligible at the main beam peak and several decibels wide on a sidelobe thirty decibels down.
